question: Herbivores form the _____ trophic level in a food chain.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Second.__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **Trophic derives** its origin from the word **"Trophe" which means "Nourishment".**
 
• Trophic level interaction deals with how the constituents of an ecosystem are connected based on their needs related to nutrition.
 
• In simple terms, **Each step in the food chain is known as a “Trophic level”.**</li&g
